Name: Colorful Braids With Flowers (FS) (CP)
Author: Gabett
Description:
[size=6][center][color=#ff0000]Co[/color][color=#ff7700]lor[/color][color=#ffff00]ful[/color] [color=#00ff00]Bra[/color][color=#00ffff]ids[/color] [color=#0000ff]With[/color] [color=#9900ff]Flow[/color][color=#ff00ff]ers[/color][/center][/size]
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

Long braids! In all kinds of colors! With flowers! What more could you wish for?
Choose from two versions:

[size=3][b]Fashion Sense (recommended):[/b][/size]

The flowers and braids have been separated in this version, which means that you can tint both independently from each other.

Under hairs you will find:
- a freely colorable braid
- all the old ombre combinations

Under accessories you will find:
- [b][color=#ffff00]NEW: [/color][/b]custom, freely tintable ombre options (check images)
- freely colorable flowers
- prismatic flowers
- rainbow flowers

[b][size=3]Content Patcher:[/size][/b]

The flower accessories are drawn directly onto the braids in this version. This means that you won't be able to recolor the flowers.
The first braid is freely tintable. For the rest to look right, you will want to set your hair color to white.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nruBucV.png[/img]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[i]For the Fashion Sense version:[/i]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url].
3. Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley / Mods [/font]OR import to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]﻿.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

OR

[i]For the Content Patcher version:[/i]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley / Mods [/font]OR import to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]﻿.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

[i]Note: There is no way to set requirements for individual files, so it will list both CP and FS when you are trying to download the file. You only need the mod that matches the version you are downloading.[/i]

[b][size=5]Permissions[/size][/b]

Don't reupload to other sites. Other than that, feel free to go to town with it, just don't forget to give me credit.
